get.description: Retrieves current API rate limit details from Jooto.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

limit.description: Maximum read requests allowed in the current window.

remaining.description: Remaining read requests in the current window.

reset.description: Unix timestamp when the read request window resets.

limit.description: Maximum update requests allowed in the current window.

remaining.description: Remaining update requests in the current window.

reset.description: Unix timestamp when the update request window resets.
